key_provisions_or_claims: Taiwanese nationals or residence permit holders may submit public policy proposals via the platform.
Proposers must supply contact information and undergo one-time phone and email verification.
Proposals limited to the Executive Yuan and its agencies' remit, with up to three responsible agencies.
Proposals may be hidden if threatening, defamatory, rights-infringing, sub judice, on cross-strait, diplomatic or defence matters.
Responsible agencies must confirm assignment within ten working days or are deemed to confirm.
annotation.summary_en: Taiwan Executive Yuan operating rules (as amended 2018) for the Join public participation platform. They set proposer eligibility, verification, proposal scope, grounds for hiding proposals, and agency confirmation procedures. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
